title: Beyond the Last Minute: A Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Approach to Academic Procrastination
description:
This 3-hour interactive workshop introduces Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy for Procrastination (MBCT-P) to help the student break the cycle of chronic delay. Rather than treating procrastination as a time-management issue, this session focuses on emotional regulation and cognitive avoidance.

The students will learn how to spot early psychological triggers, such as perfectionism, task anxiety, and overwhelm, before they turn into avoidance. Through practical mindfulness practices and cognitive reframing tools, the students will gain actionable strategies to sit with discomfort, quiet the internal pressure to perform perfectly, and move from passive delay into intentional action.

title: Mindfulness in Everyday Life
description: In this 2-hour workshop, you will be introduced to mindfulness as a valuable skill in managing stress, coping with difficult situations, and as a self-care technique. The workshop's design will allow you to engage in mindfulness practices that you can apply daily. This workshop will also discuss the basics of mindfulness, the science behind mindfulness and its effect on mental health, and mindfulness practices that you can incorporate into your daily activities.

title: [SSC] Emotional Self-regulation (Run 1)
description: This session will help students understand the importance of emotional self-regulation when it comes to success in school, in the workplace and in personal relationships.  It will also present several strategies to strengthen emotional self-regulation skill.

title: [SSC] Emotional Self-regulation (Run 2)
description: This session will help students understand the importance of emotional self-regulation when it comes to success in school, in the workplace and in personal relationships.  It will also present several strategies to strengthen emotional self-regulation skill.

title: [SSC] Interpersonal Effectiveness: Cultivating Healthy Relationships Personally and Professionally (RUN 1)
description: This module helps students communicate effectively in ways that will nurture and enhance their relationships -- may it be personal or professional, address conflicts or issues when they arise, all while leaving them a greater sense of self-respect.

title: [SSC] Interpersonal Effectiveness: Cultivating Healthy Relationships Personally and Professionally (RUN 2)
description: This module helps students communicate effectively in ways that will nurture and enhance their relationships -- may it be personal or professional, address conflicts or issues when they arise, all while leaving them a greater sense of self-respect.

title: [SSC] Personal Leadership | Time Management
description: This module is dedicated to emphasizing time management, a foundational skill in the cultivation of leadership abilities. Within this module, students will engage in a workshop centered around Covey's Time Management Framework, which aids in identifying and implementing strategies for becoming adept and productive leaders by appropriately organizing and prioritizing various tasks.

title: [SSC] Negotiate Anything with Anyone on a Day-To-Day (RUN 1) F2F
description: People don’t realize how much we negotiate in a day. And compared to pre-pandemic, people are used negotiating face-to-face. With the development of technology and spending more time communicating with online platforms, it is important to understand how we can better our negotiating skills and make a business approach solution a day-to-day life style. This module will help you become aware of negotiating opportunities, and potentially closing deals effectively. The module will share strategies, and how to overcome challenges in negotiating.

title: [SSC] Breaking Barriers to Success (RUN 1) F2F
description: Success is one thing we all want to achieve. But to be able to get this, we usually stumbled upon various barriers that are brought by both internal and external factors. These factors usually hinder us from taking the journey to our greatest potential, and this module endeavors to help you navigate your way to success with a stronger mindset and equipped with perspectives that will help build, set plans and kick-start your successful journey.

title: Lasallian Entrepreneurship and Design Thinking (LSEDT)
description:
Design Thinking is a human-centered and iterative approach to problem-solving that focuses on understanding people’s needs, defining the right problem, and developing meaningful solutions. It involves empathizing, defining, ideating, prototyping, and testing ideas through collaboration and continuous feedback.

It includes a mini workshop: The “Wallet Project”

description:
Circular Economy and Social Innovation focuses on developing sustainable and inclusive solutions that rethink how resources are used, products are designed, and communities create value. title: Discipline Education Caravan: Paano Nga Ba? – Navigating the Ethics of AI-Assisted Learning
description: Anchored in the Lasallian pursuit of truth, this module challenges students to move beyond passive reliance on AI toward critical thinking, self-directed learning, and the responsible, ethical command of emerging technology.

title: Discipline Education Caravan: Paano Nga Ba? – Smart Productivity: EdTech Solutions for Habit Building and Goal Execution
description: Reflecting a zeal for excellence, this module empowers Lasallians to rise above digital distractions, build intentional daily routines, and steward their time effectively in service of their goals.

title: Discipline Education Caravan: Paano Nga Ba? – Managing Frustration: Emotional Regulation, Self-Control, and Respectful Communication
description: Embodying the Lasallian value of communion and respect for human dignity, this module equips students to navigate academic friction and group conflict with emotional control, empathy, and constructive communication.

title: Discipline Education Caravan: Paano Nga Ba? – Controlling Impulse Spending: Personal Budgeting and Financial Stewardship
description: Rooted in the value of stewardship, this module guides Lasallians to resist impulsive digital consumerism, practice emotional self-regulation, and align their financial choices with intentional, value-driven living.

title: Discipline Education Caravan: Paano Nga Ba? – Cultivating Digital Vigilance: Cybersecurity, Data Privacy, and Risk Awareness
description: Guided by social responsibility and care for the community, this module cultivates digital vigilance, teaching Lasallians to practice sound cyber hygiene and treat data privacy as an active reflection of personal ethics.

title: [SSC] Understanding Financial Literacy: Practical Steps for Personal Finances (Run 1)
description: Managing money doesn’t have to be overwhelming. This seminar simplifies key financial principles—like budgeting, saving, and debt management—into clear, practical steps for everyday life. Perfect for beginners and those seeking to strengthen their financial habits, it focuses on applying knowledge to real situations. Gain confidence, make smarter financial choices, and start building a foundation for lasting stability and growth.

title: [SSC] Beyond "Are You OK?": How to Truly Support Someone in Distress [Run 2]
description: Ever feel helpless when a friend or classmate is going through a really rough time? This seminar provides a practical roadmap for identifying and safely supporting individuals experiencing a mental health crisis or emotional overwhelm. Participants will learn how to spot the subtle, early warning signs of psychological distress and navigate critical conversations with confidence, care, and clear boundaries. By unpacking the H.E.L.P framework, this session equips you with the tools needed to be an effective lifeline without losing your own footing.

title: [SSC] Vibe Checks & Group Projects: Collaborating When You Just Don't Click [Run 3]

Participants will learn how to navigate interpersonal conflict objectively, safeguard project outcomes, and develop the essential leadership skills that recruiters actively look for.

title:
Safe Spaces for All! 
Advancing Gender Equality
 with the Safe Spaces Act
description: This module will explore the significance of the Safe Spaces Act (RA 11313) in fostering inclusive, harassment-free environments. It will highlight the key purpose of the law, its role in promoting gender equality, and practical steps for implementing safe spaces in various settings, such as schools and workplaces. Participants will gain insights into how the Safe Spaces Act serves as a tool for empowering individuals, fostering respect, and creating a culture of safety for all.
developer: Mr. Christian Derek S. Guerra, lcidw@dlsu.edu.ph
